original.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds support for selecting ACME certificate profiles (e.g. tlsserver, shortlived) when requesting certificates from an ACME CA.

decision.reason: [ev-50f787991f0d] says cert-manager now supports selecting ACME certificate profiles, using the ACME protocol extension for certificate profiles (IETF draft). That makes it a new protocol-level capability, so the change type "added" is right. The excerpt names no CRD field, Helm value, flag or key for choosing a profile. That leaves protocol-behavior as the best-supported family, and "acme-certificate-profiles" is built from the evidence's own key words.
